en.headline: Labour Department issues Amber Heat Stress at Work Warning
en.dek: The Labour Department said some workplaces face fairly high heat stress after issuing an Amber warning at 9.50am, and told employers to take heat-stroke precautions.
body: The Labour Department issued an Amber Heat Stress at Work Warning at 9.50am on Saturday, saying heat stress in some working environments is fairly high. The department asked employers and employees to take appropriate measures while the warning is in force to reduce the risk of heat stroke in hot weather or hot indoor settings.

A department reminder said staff working outdoors or in indoor workplaces without air-conditioning face higher heat stress. Employers should assess heat-stress risk factors for those jobs and take control measures such as rearranging work periods, providing shade, improving ventilation and reminding workers to drink water and rest.

The warning system, refined from Friday, has three levels — Amber, Red and Black — and is based on the Hong Kong Heat Index, temperatures recorded across the city, and any Extremely Hot Weather Special Alert from the Observatory. The Labour Department said employers must follow its Guidance Notes on Prevention of Heat Stroke at Work when assessing outdoor and non-air-conditioned indoor work.
Employees who develop symptoms such as headache, dizziness, thirst or nausea should move to a cooler place, drink water and notify a supervisor, the department said.

zh.headline: 勞工處發出黃色工作暑熱警告
zh.dek: 勞工處今早時9時50分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，指部分工作環境熱壓力頗高，提醒僱主及僱員採取防暑措施。
body: 勞工處今日上午9時50分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境的熱壓力頗高。處方針對警告生效期間，提醒僱主及僱員採取適當措施，預防在酷熱天氣或高溫環境工作時中暑。
勞工處表示，在戶外或沒有空調的室內環境工作的僱員會面對較高水平的熱壓力，中暑風險亦相對較高。僱主應評估相關熱壓力風險，並因應情況採取預防及控制措施，包括重新編排工作時段、設置遮蔭、加強通風散熱，以及提醒僱員適時補水和休息。
工作暑熱警告分為黃、紅、黑三級，由周五起按優化機制運作，綜合香港暑熱指數、全港氣溫，以及天文台有否發出極端酷熱天氣特別提示。勞工處指，僱主須參照《預防工作時中暑指引》，為戶外及沒有空調的室內工作進行風險評估。
處方提醒，僱員如出現頭痛、頭暈、口渴或惡心等熱疾病徵狀，應立即到陰涼處休息和飲水，並通知僱主或主管採取適當行動。
